svg.title: Project orbit map
svg.desc: Seventeen projects in four orbits around OrbitWatch. Systems and IoT: ResQMesh, AeroSense, Algal bloom, ECOSAT. AI and data: fIndia-AI, TideLine, Suraksha, Cheating detection. Developer tools: CodeLens, IntelliReview, SecureGraph, File Integrity, Downloader. Web and sound: Swaralaya, TOOL, KRAKEN, Decentralized Election.
svg.text: 17 projects, four orbits, one core. Slow on purpose.
